requiredMethods.name: reviewTransaction
requiredMethods.purpose: Display network, draft path, txid, inputs, outputs, fees, version, lock time, payload bytes, and route before any user action.

requiredMethods.name: submitReviewedTransaction
requiredMethods.purpose: Submit the reviewed transaction without changing payload bytes, lock time, input fields, or version-1 computeBudget values.

requiredMethods.name: recordSubmitResult
requiredMethods.purpose: Return txid, submitted route, timestamp, and accepted/rejected/error state for indexer ingestion.

routePolicy.payload: Use payload-preserving JSON wRPC or wallet submit. Do not use public REST submit for payload drafts.
routePolicy.contract: Preserve exact transaction version, inputs, outputs, lock time, and computeBudget fields.
routePolicy.standard: Require user review before signing or broadcasting.

boundaries: This is the connector request bundle the browser/wallet should exchange, not a browser-held private-key flow.
Existing artifacts are already signed local drafts; this bundle is the exact-review and submit contract for replacing local shell submission.
Payload requests must reject REST submit routes that drop payload bytes.
Version-1 contract requests must preserve computeBudget and must not rewrite it to sigOpCount.
